lines: This pyramid is made of 2.3 million stone blocks. And they built it without cranes.
Step one. Drag each two-and-a-half-tonne block on a wooden sledge. Pouring water on the sand roughly halves the pulling force.
Step two. Build it layer by layer. A leading theory says the ramps grew taller with every layer, for about twenty years.
Then the capstone went on top, and polished white limestone covered the steps.
At 146 meters, it was the tallest thing humans built, for about 3,800 years.
